title: SPE Chapter 07 - PDO: Database Access with SQLite
description:
Chapter 07 of Simple PHP Engine - introducing PDO database access and the shared library.

This tutorial covers:
• First use of shared app/lib/ library code
• PDO database wrapper with CRUD methods
• QueryType enum for fetch modes (All, One, Col)
• Dynamic navigation from database pages
• Blog plugin with full CRUD operations
• Markdown rendering for content
• Session integration (sticky params, flash messages)
• Auto-creating SQLite database
